subject.title: feat(chat): show live run telemetry across clients

question: Should OpenClaw make persistent live run telemetry and a completed-turn recap the default chat behavior across Control UI, iOS/macOS, and Android after real-client proof is supplied?
rationale: This is a broad user-facing presentation policy spanning three clients; focused tests establish implementation intent but cannot decide the permanent product behavior or substitute for live lifecycle evidence.

options.title: Sponsor the shared telemetry behavior
options.body: Accept the cross-client UX direction after the contributor supplies redacted real-run evidence and the remaining client checks complete.

options.title: Narrow the initial rollout
options.body: Land the behavior first on the client surface with the strongest live proof and track native parity separately.

options.title: Keep current presentation
options.body: Decline the persistent recap/telemetry direction and close the implementation path without merging it.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared telemetry behavior
recommendation.body: Accept the cross-client UX direction after the contributor supplies redacted real-run evidence and the remaining client checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history shows this person authored the cross-client behavior and its compatibility refinements.
